=== Rewards ===
*[[Rada's blessing 2]]:
**Five daily teleports to the [[Kourend Woodland]]
**4% chance to catch two [[fish]] at once anywhere when equipped, excluding at [[Tempoross]]' [[Tempoross Cove|Cove]] (no additional experience granted)
**Has a [[Prayer bonus]] of +1 when equipped, similar to the [[God blessing|god blessings]]
*[[Antique lamp (medium)|Antique lamp]] worth 7,500 experience in any skill of at least level 40
*Free access to [[Crabclaw Isle]], down from a fee of 5,000 [[coins]]
*40% discount on [[Eodan]]'s [[tanner|tanning]] services, up from 20%
*5% chance to mine two [[dense essence block]]s at once
*[[Thirus]] offers you 20 [[dynamite]] for free every day, worth a total of {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Dynamite}}*20}} [[coins]] on the [[Grand Exchange]]
